title: Critter Kart 萌兽卡丁车
description: A cute 3D item kart racer in candy-sweet Sugarloop Valley: six critter racers, drift and slipstream boosts, candy coins and seven power-ups including Sugar Rush and Gumball Bomb. Play free in your browser in English, 简体中文 or 日本語.

defaultCaptions.x: Drift, boost and bubble-bomb your way through Sugarloop Valley in Critter Kart 🍭🏁 Six critter racers, seven power-ups, free in your browser.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Critter Kart is a cute 3D kart racer set in candy-sweet Sugarloop Valley. Pick one of six critters, chain drift boosts, grab candy coins and fire off seven power-ups — right in your browser.
